name: Bartolo's Yeti Fur Cloak

angles.text: Bartolo boasts that his Yeti Fur Cloak is renowned throughout the Alliance. He offers his tailoring from Southshore, an Alliance stronghold.
The garment calls for a Bolt of Wool and Fine Thread, along with exotic beast pelts.

faq.answer: Bartolo Ginsetti is an eccentric, boastful craftsman in Southshore, in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He claims to have made an unrivaled, world-famous Yeti Fur Cloak.
Bartolo needs a Bolt of Wool, a Hillman's Cloak made by a leatherworker, Fine Thread, and ten clumps of Yeti Fur.
faq.q: What materials does Bartolo require to make the cloak?

faq.answer: Bartolo makes his cloaks in Southshore, a coastal human town and the main Alliance hub in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He welcomes travelers passing through the region.
faq.q: Where does Bartolo make his cloaks?

faq.answer: Wild yetis in the foothills and mountains of Hillsbrad and Alterac carry clumps of Yeti Fur. Their coats are dense and insulating.
faq.q: Where do adventurers obtain Yeti Fur in Hillsbrad?

faq.answer: A skilled leatherworker patterns and stitches the Hillman's Cloak that Bartolo uses as his base garment. He adds wool, Fine Thread, and fur to it.
faq.q: How is the Hillman's Cloak acquired?

faq.answer: Bartolo says no finer cloak exists anywhere on the planet. He boasts that it is renowned throughout the Alliance and offers unmatched warmth, luxury, and prestige.
faq.q: Why does Bartolo claim his cloak is world famous?

sections.body: Travelers in coastal Southshore can commission a Yeti Fur Cloak from Bartolo Ginsetti. The artisan boasts that no finer garment exists anywhere on the planet. His work draws on materials gathered from the local wilderness and the skill of allied trades.
sections.title: The Grand Tailor of Southshore

sections.body: Bartolo needs more than a pelt and needle to make his cloak. Bring him a Bolt of Wool, Fine Thread, a Hillman's Cloak, and ten clumps of Yeti Fur from beasts roaming the foothills. With those goods in hand, he works the raw materials into his cold-weather mantle.
sections.title: Components of the Craft

summary: In Southshore, Bartolo Ginsetti gathers materials for Bartolo's Yeti Fur Cloak. The eccentric artisan claims his mantle is renowned throughout the Alliance and calls for tailoring supplies, a leatherworker's cloak, and raw yeti fur.
